morning.caption:
US stocks posted their best week since April 2025: the S&P 500 rose 5.6%, the Nasdaq 6.7% and the Dow 5.5% in the week to November 27, while the 10 year Treasury yield rose to 4.94% and markets priced a December Fed hike.

midday.caption:
Dangote Petroleum Refinery is set to begin trading on the Nigerian Exchange on Tuesday, December 1, after a share sale that raised $2.08 billion, 30% above its base target, Billionaires.Africa reports citing Bloomberg. The listing values the refinery at about $47.8 billion.

evening.caption:
Spain holds a general election on Sunday, November 29, with 176 of 350 seats needed for a majority. A GAD3 poll for ABC projects 131 seats for the PP, 110 for the PSOE and 63 for Vox. The official count is due December 4.

Also watch OPEC+ on Sunday and Asia and Europe opens Monday. General information. More at fiopoin.com
